name: NBHD Journal Shaping
description: Read and replace the enabled tenant's default daily-note template sections.

apiBaseUrl.description: Override NBHD API base URL. Defaults to NBHD_API_BASE_URL env var.

requestTimeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for NBHD runtime endpoint requests.

journalShapingEnabled.description: Register the default journal template read/update tools. Fail-closed: anything but true registers no tools.
